name: hou_mcp_asset_sync
description: Synchronize local and external asset libraries. Actions: sync_provider, sync_library (local dir scan), validate (compare storage vs provider), history. No Houdini scene changes.
python_code:
from src.nodes.base import BaseNode
from src.runtime.assets.cache.asset_sync import get_asset_sync
import json

class Hou_Mcp_Asset_Sync(BaseNode):
    name = "hou_mcp_asset_sync"

    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        # [AUTO-GENERATED-PORTS-START]
        self.add_input("action",        "string", widget_type="text", default="sync_provider")
        self.add_input("provider_name", "string", widget_type="text")
        self.add_input("library_path",  "string", widget_type="text")
        self.add_output("sync_report_json", "string")
        self.add_output("assets_found",     "int")
        self.add_output("assets_new",       "int")
        self.add_output("valid",            "bool")
        self.add_output("history_json",     "string")
        # [AUTO-GENERATED-PORTS-END]

    async def execute(self, inputs):
        action        = (inputs.get("action") or "sync_provider").strip().lower()
        provider_name = inputs.get("provider_name") or ""
        library_path  = inputs.get("library_path") or ""
        sync          = get_asset_sync()

        sync_report_json = "{}"
        assets_found     = 0
        assets_new       = 0
        valid            = False
        history_json     = "[]"

        try:
            if action == "sync_provider" and provider_name:
                report = sync.sync_provider(provider_name)
                sync_report_json = json.dumps(report.to_dict(), default=str)
                assets_found = report.assets_found
                assets_new   = report.assets_new
                valid        = len(report.errors) == 0
                self.log_info(f"Sync '{provider_name}': found={assets_found} new={assets_new}")

            elif action == "sync_library" and library_path and provider_name:
                report = sync.sync_library(library_path, provider_name)
                sync_report_json = json.dumps(report.to_dict(), default=str)
                assets_found = report.assets_found
                assets_new   = report.assets_new
                valid        = len(report.errors) == 0

            elif action == "validate" and provider_name:
                result = sync.validate_sync(provider_name)
                sync_report_json = json.dumps(result, default=str)
                valid = result.get("valid", False)

            elif action == "history":
                history_json = json.dumps(sync.get_sync_history(), default=str)

        except Exception as exc:
            self.log_error(f"AssetSync error: {exc}")

        return {
            "sync_report_json": sync_report_json,
            "assets_found":     assets_found,
            "assets_new":       assets_new,
            "valid":            valid,
            "history_json":     history_json,
            "exec_out": True,
        }

def register_node():
    return Hou_Mcp_Asset_Sync
